status: recorded, deliberately not fixed this wave
discovered_by: code-reviewer on the session-3 gameplay-wiring diff

items.defect: ABEgg.OnCollisionEnter2D overrides the base handler without calling base and without calling PhysicalSnapshotRuntime.RecordCollisionCallback, so an egg impact is invisible to physics_capture_v1 — the same class of defect this wave fixed in ABBirdBlack.
why_left_out: The authorization for this wave covers exactly two gameplay callbacks: ABBirdBlack.OnCollisionEnter2D and ABBlock.OnCollisionEnter2D.
ABEgg is not reachable on the level the smoke plays, so fixing it buys the gate nothing.
It would add a third gameplay change to the build surface immediately before a deterministic rebuild and a single non-retryable smoke.
items.downstream_impact: Any future cohort that uses a white bird (egg-dropping) will under-report collisions. This must be fixed before such a cohort is collected.
items.recommended_next_wave_action: Apply the same one-line direct RecordCollisionCallback call, with an EditMode fixture mirroring BirdBlackImpactRecordsACollisionEventWithContractGradeEvidence.

items.defect: The smoke harness does not scan the engine log for the new refusal message 'physics_capture_v1: refusing'. A run in which the recorder refused every collision would surface only as 'no collision', without the reason.
why_left_out: Editing scripts/smoke_physics_capture.py forces updating the pinned source digest 72f6a12183df97755ab715919557d70eb7cf5c59e9c8311dcab0c9925288b6f6 in mutation_check.py, or the harness refuses to run.
It adds a change to the harness immediately before the single non-retryable smoke.
The smoke already fails closed on zero collisions, so the absence of the scan cannot turn a bad run into a passing one — it only costs diagnostic detail.
items.mitigation_this_wave: The engine log is captured by the smoke run and can be grepped for the refusal string by hand if the run reports no collision.
items.recommended_next_wave_action: Add the log scan together with the mutation_check.py digest update, as one commit, outside a gate run.
